title: Knot types as a basis for the tensor tower
html: Each braid closure \hat\beta meets the summands S_\lambda of 7.3.49 through the components y_\lambda\chi_\lambda(\rho_n(\beta)) of its Markov trace. In this reading, knot types play the role of a basis for \varinjlim V^{\otimes n}, and the algebraic direct limit takes the place of Feynman's continuum integral. The reading is not a statement about eigenvectors: the summands are labelled by partitions, many knots share a summand, and one closure generally meets several.
